children: Property website Rightmove continues to grow revenue and profits despite the challenges faced by the U.K.'s housing market, RBC Capital Markets analysts say. Its new AI product saw consumers engaging with conversational AI, staying longer on site and sending over three times as many leads, RBC says. The company's tightening of its full-year sales and core profit forecasts to more precise targets and raising of its adjusted EPS growth to at least 7%--just shy of the 7.9% consensus--is positive, RBC says. This shows that high-margin product sales and cost controls are continuing to pay off, even in a tougher broader market, RBC says. Shares are down 0.55% at 547.50 pence. (anthony.orunagoriainoff@dowjones.com)
